Listed below is all our developed and used HTML-source code for all our used GoPhish Templates. It will be broken into sections for an easier viewing experience. GoPhish allows you to create a phishing campaign for specific users/groups, so for each of our templates, there will be two separate sets of information including the email templates, and landing pages. Make sure to always checkmark on landing pages to capture submitted data to ensure launched campaigns inform you when a user submits data to the phishing scams. For sending profiles, we made sure the SMTP from sections were the same as the envelope senders for the email templates and hosted the profiles using the address: 127.0.0.1:1025. Leave the username and passwords empty for sending profiles and make sure to checkmark ignore certificate errors. The host address will allow you to send these phishing emails to MailHog with ease when sending test emails to make sure the templates worked.

<style type="text/css">body {
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      background-color: #f4f4f4;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }
    .container {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
      margin: 80px auto;
      background: #ffffff;
      padding: 30px;
      border-radius: 6px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border: 1px solid #dddddd;
    }
    h2 {
      text-align: center;
      color: #333333;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      font-size: 20px;
    }
    label {
      font-size: 14px;
      color: #333333;
      display: block;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }
    input[type="text"], input[type="password"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 15px;
      border: 1px solid #cccccc;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    button {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px;
      background-color: #1a73e8;
      border: none;
      color: #ffffff;
      font-size: 15px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    button:hover {
      background-color: #1666c4;
    }
    .footer {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 15px;
      font-size: 12px;
      color: #777777;
    }
</style>

<div class="footer">IT Support Center • Security Verification Portal</div>
</div>
</body></html>

	<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
	<title>Governors State University – Password Update Portal</title>

	<style type="text/css">body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
      background: #f4f4f4;
      color: #333;
    }

    .header {
      background: #1A3D7C;
      color: #fff;
      padding: 14px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }

    .header img {
      height: 48px;
    }

    .header-text {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .header-text .title {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .header-text .subtitle {
      font-size: 13px;
      opacity: 0.9;
    }

    .container {
      max-width: 420px;
      margin: 40px auto;
      background: #fff;
      padding: 28px;
      border-radius: 8px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .form-title {
      font-size: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      color: #1A3D7C;
      font-weight: bold;
    }

    .form-subtitle {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: #555;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    label {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      margin-bottom: 6px;
      color: #444;
    }

    input[type="email"],
    input[type="password"] {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      border: 1px solid #ccc;
      font-size: 14px;
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    .hint {
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #777;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 10px 0;
      background: #F47A1F;
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 4px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 600;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: #d86819;
    }

    .footer-text {
      margin-top: 16px;
      font-size: 11px;
      color: #777;
      text-align: center;
    }

<body>
<div class="header"><img alt="Governors State University Logo" src="data:image/jpg;base64,"/>
<div class="header-text">
<div class="title">Governors State University</div>

<div class="subtitle">Account Services – Password Update</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="container">
<div class="form-title">Password Update Required</div>
